invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of getDependencyAssetDescriptors, which should not return null.
The tmjFile parameter is used directly as input to json.parse and getDependencyAssetDescriptors, so it cannot be null.
If parameter is not null, its texture filter fields are dereferenced and assigned.
Arrays in LibGDX should never have a negative size.
As a required input string, fileName is expected not to be null.
